name: writing-from-notes
title_zh: 动笔前先翻旧笔记的写作起手式
tagline_zh: 写论文、总结、博客前，总觉得自己没货？它先翻你读过的书、做过的笔记，把散落的观点拼成初稿骨架，不让你对着空白页发呆。
tagline_en: Stuck before writing essays, posts, or docs? It digs through your past reading and notes, assembling scattered.
desc_en: Use when starting a substantive piece of writing — essay, summary, post, design doc, blog draft — where the topic has been encountered in past reading or work.
why_zh: 不靠灵感靠库存：它把你过往的阅读痕迹当素材库，按主题自动检索、排序、串联。
why_en: No inspiration needed—it mines your reading history as a stockpile, auto-searching, ranking, and linking notes by theme.
limit_zh: 只认本地笔记库（如 Obsidian、Zotero），且笔记需有可检索的文本；不接云端、不读 PDF 扫描件。
limit_en: Works only with local note libraries (e.g., Obsidian, Zotero) with searchable text; no cloud, no scanned PDFs. Output is an outline with material.
title_en: A writing starter that digs through your old notes first
